title: Memorials of the Faithful
textType: Authoritative text and recorded talk of ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá
author: abdul-baha
attributionNote: Memorials of the Faithful, by ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá: the Bahá’í Reference Library's own record of the work, on its ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá shelf.
description: Eulogies of some eighty early Bahá’ís transcribed from a series of talks given by ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá in Haifa around 1914–15. The Persian transcripts were later corrected by ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá and compiled into a single volume, published in 1924. An English translation was published in 1971. The record was created by the Bahá’í import from the Reference Library's own catalogue and reading views; the summary above is the library's own description of the work, and an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Bahá’í Reference Library, in the section where the Bahá’í International Community publishes the authorised English text (‘Abdu’l‑Bahá).
availabilityNote: Complete as the Reference Library publishes it: the library's reading views for this work are streamed from bahai.org at read time, one chapter at a time, with the Community's copyright notice. The chapters are the divisions of the library's own reading text; the publication's front matter and its notes are not imported.
